intent.text: Recommend that plans like the vsect maturation plan be checked by one independent reviewer from another model family as the standard baseline, reserving full councils for high-stakes irremediable shifts or when the cross-family reviewer identifies structural deadlocks. A reviewer from a distinct model family provides the critical cognitive diversity needed to catch blind spots, unstated assumptions, and shared training-distribution biases that same-family reviewers routinely gloss over, achieving the majority of defect-reduction benefits without council overhead.
